# Nova API — /api/model-endpoints

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/model-endpoints`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## GET /api/model-endpoints

Operation id `model_endpoints_list`: in Python `client.call("model_endpoints_list", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api model_endpoints_list`.

`GET /api/model-endpoints`: the models an administrator connected to the platform.

Every `ModelEndpoint` of the platform namespace, name order: `name`, `model`, `location` (`on-premise` | `cloud`, default `on-premise`), `purposes` (default `["ask","agents"]`), `sendRows` (may query results be sent to this model; off by default), the quota of `spec.quota` — `perGroupMonthlyTokens` and `perPersonDailyTokens`, each `null` for no limit — and the probe's last answer — `reachable`, `toolCalling`, `jsonOutput`, `contextTokens`, `checkedAt`, `message`, each `null` until the probe has run. The endpoint's `url` and its `keyRef` are absent on purpose: the shape says that a model exists, what it is, where prompts go and whether it works, never the internal hostname or the name of the Connection holding the key. Without a cluster connection (a local run) the answer is an empty list: no endpoint means no AI feature. A cluster that refuses or fails is a 502, never an empty list that would read as "no model". Answers `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | One row per endpoint, name order; empty when none is connected |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `502` | The cluster did not answer, or Nova may not list modelendpoints |
